issues.on_page: Warrants issued current year unpaid 295,675; Warrants issued prior year paid (1,655,920)
issues.issue: Extractor rules say SID warrant/bond proceeds go to debt_proceeds; the 295,675 of warrants issued was netted into other_financing instead (SIDs 346/347 put warrants issued in debt_proceeds). Arithmetic and identity hold either way (debt_proceeds would be 1,480,675 and other_financing -1,655,920).
